title: Certain families of series involving Hurwitz and Lerch zeta functions
summary: This paper deals with a certain family of series which is derived from generating functions of the Frobenius-Euler and Apostol type polynomials and numbers. When special cases of this series are examined, it is shown that it generates some well-known families of zeta functions, such as the Hurwitz zeta and the Lerch zeta, etc. We also give an open problem for these relation. We give analytic continuation of this function. By using the Cauchy Residue Theorem, We show that this series interpolates the Frobenius-Euler type polynomials at negative integers.
